pr_title: testutil_init.c: fix compilation error with enable-trace
pr_body:
In commit e79ae962fbed the tests were adapted to use the
new BIO_f_prefix() API which was introduced in 319cee9e2fc6.
This location was missed, because it is compiled only when
tracing is enabled.

Fixes #10731

issue_context.title: test/testutil/testutil_init.c does not compile with enable-trace
issue_context.body:
When configured with `enable_trace` I get

review_comments: No strdup() should happen here: The prefix is set to NULL, i.e., only a previously set prefix is cleared.
This call does a strdup internally which may fail and return 0 (not likely).. Does the error code need to be checked?

Hmmm... this is low level tracing code. Failing is not an option imho and placing some error message between the trace messages might be confusing. Anyway,  If the strdup() fails, all that happens is that the prefix will be missing. So I'd tend to keep the code simple and don't do an error check here.
